-- <pre>
local lib = require("Module:Feature")
local p    = {}
local data = mw.loadData('Module:ChampionData/data')

local function getData(champname, stat)
	if stat then
		return data[champname] and data[champname].stats or {}
	else
		return data[champname] or {}
	end
end

local function getDataStat(champname, stat)
	return getData(champname, true)[stat] or {}
end

function p.id(champname)
    return getData(champname).id
end

function p.windup(champname)
	local act = getData(champname, true).attack_cast_time
	local att = getData(champname, true).attack_total_time
    if act and att then
        return act / att
    else
        return 0.3 + (getData(champname, true).attack_delay_offset or 0)
    end
end

function p.changes_sortkey(champname)
	local changes = getData(champname).changes
	if changes ~= nil then
		local s, e, major, minor, hotfix = changes:find('V?(%d%d?)%.(%d%d?)(%a?)')
		if s ~= nil then
			return string.format("%02d%02d%01d", tonumber(major), tonumber(minor), (string.byte(hotfix:lower()) or 96) - 96)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function p.role(champname) -- table
    return getData(champname).role
end

function p.external_positions(champname) -- table
    return getData(champname).external_positions
end

function p.all_positions(champname) -- table
    local riot_pos  = data[champname].client_positions
    local ext_pos    = data[champname].external_positions
    
    local sets      = {}
    local hash      = {}
    
    for _, value in pairs(riot_pos) do
       if (not hash[value]) then
           table.insert(sets, value)
           hash[value] = true
       end
    end
    
    for _, value in pairs(ext_pos) do
       if (not hash[value]) then
           table.insert(sets, value)
           hash[value] = true
       end
    end
    
    return sets
end

-- Game mode changes data getter / also see [[Module:MapChanges]]
local gamemodePercentageMods = {"dmg_dealt", "dmg_taken", "healing", "shielding", "manaregen_mod", "energyregen_mod", "total_as", "ms_mod", "tenacity"}

for i = 1, #gamemodePercentageMods do
	gamemodePercentageMods[gamemodePercentageMods[i]] = true
	gamemodePercentageMods[i] = nil
end

local gamemodeStatGetter = {
	__call = function (self, champname)
		local statTable = getData(champname, true)
		if statTable[self.gamemode] ~= nil then
			local gamemodeStatValue = statTable[self.gamemode][self.stat]
			if gamemodeStatValue ~= nil and lib.ternary(gamemodePercentageMods[self.stat] == true, gamemodeStatValue ~= 1, gamemodeStatValue ~= 0) then -- returning nil when value exists but is unchanged
				local baseStat = statTable[self.stat] or 0-- initialize zero when the stat is a special modifier (no corresponding "default" type of stat like health, attack damage,.... have)
				return baseStat + gamemodeStatValue
			end
		end
		return nil	
	end
}

local gamemode = mw.loadData("Module:GamemodeData/data")

setmetatable(p, {
	__index = function(self, k)
		--being here means that p[k] does not currently exist
		local indexFind = k:find("_", 1, true) -- only works if "_" is used as a divider and is not contained within the gamemodeName
		if indexFind ~= nil then
			local inputGamemode = k:sub(1, indexFind - 1)
			if (gamemode[inputGamemode]) then -- does the input contain a gamemode?
				--as long as we have a valid gameMode, we create the function so it's more accessible next time,
				--regardless of what stat is being looked for.
				local stat = k:sub(indexFind + 1)
				p[k] = {gamemode = inputGamemode, stat = stat}
				setmetatable(p[k], gamemodeStatGetter)
				return p[k]
			end
		end
	end
})

return p
